home.heroTitle: Building the future of civic technology
home.heroSubtitle: Rayan Tamaddon Jahan Gostar builds creative, innovative software that makes life simpler for people and work simpler for organisations — from custom software and web and mobile apps to enterprise platforms and open-source projects.
home.missionBody: Rayan Tamaddon Jahan Gostar designs and develops software — open source above all — for individuals, businesses and organisations, built professionally and fitted precisely to each client’s business and specialist needs. Our commitment is software of the highest possible quality, delivered in the shortest time and at the most efficient cost.
home.visionBody: Our vision is a fully intelligent civilisation: a world where the digital is woven into every detail of our personal and social lives, so that we can make the most of the remarkable opportunity that life is.
home.whatWeDoSubtitle: Software engineering, from ideation and architecture through development, deployment and support
home.feature0Desc: Software designed around your processes and goals — step by step, intelligently, with as much automation as possible and always under your oversight. From consulting to deployment.
home.feature1Desc: Fast, scalable, user-friendly web and mobile apps, built to the highest standards of quality and performance.
home.feature2Desc: Platforms that bring organisations, institutions and people closer together, so every service is just one click away.
home.feature3Desc: Turning raw data into interactive dashboards, clear reports and actionable insight, for simpler and smarter decisions.
home.howWeWorkSubtitle: Open source, community-driven, and open to newcomers
home.work0Desc: Much of what we build is released openly, so other people can build on it. The code is transparent and auditable with no vendor lock-in; a wide community tests its security, ownership costs less, and the software always stays yours.
home.work1Desc: Our teams work in defined roles, alongside a global community of developers. More review means fewer defects, faster innovation and solutions that grow with what users really need.
home.work2Desc: We keep a route into the software industry open for juniors and career-changers. Real projects alongside experienced engineers bring talent to the surface and make our team stronger every day.
home.alsoInsuranceTitle: Insurance services: online applications and advice
home.alsoInsuranceDesc: One of our secondary services is online insurance applications, because the financial security, safety and peace of mind of our colleagues and clients matter to us. Apply for any cover — from third-party and car body to supplementary health, life and liability — on a form made for that product, and follow it with a tracking code; our specialists will also recommend the plans and packages that best fit your needs and budget.
home.ctaSubtitle: Share your idea and get a free cost estimate and technical proposal — or get in touch for technical consulting or to join the team.

about.title: About Rayan Tamaddon Jahan Gostar
about.subtitle: We are a software engineering company that builds creative, innovative solutions to make life simpler for people and work simpler for organisations.
about.missionBody: To help civilisation get more out of technology every day. To that end, we design and develop software of every kind — open source above all — for individuals, businesses and organisations: professionally, fitted precisely to each client’s business and specialist needs, to the highest quality, in the shortest time and at the most efficient cost. We do it by building software that matters, through open-source projects and collaboration with a global community.
about.visionBody: A fully intelligent civilisation, where the digital is woven into every detail of our personal and social lives so that we can make the most of the remarkable opportunity that life is. On the way there, we want to be a home for open-source engineering and for the next generation of engineers — where serious work gets done and the door stays open to newcomers.
about.whatWeDoBody: From ideation and design through development, deployment and maintenance, we build custom software, web and mobile apps, enterprise and civic-tech platforms, and data analytics and visualisation solutions. Our work is open source, community-driven and open to newcomers. Alongside the engineering, we run a marketplace for job openings and freelance projects, and take insurance applications online.
about.value1Desc: We understand a problem at its root, then build a new, intelligent solution for it.
about.value2Desc: We describe our work, our decisions and our limits as they actually are — from the cost estimate to every progress report.
about.value3Desc: We build in the open and with others, not in isolation — and that collaboration stays open to newcomers.
about.value4Desc: We never trade engineering quality for speed: we deliver fast because we build it right from the start.
about.legalNote: CiviTech Global is the international brand of Rayan Tamaddon Jahan Gostar.

services.title: Software design and development services
services.subtitle: Software engineering is at the centre of what we do — custom software, web and mobile apps, enterprise platforms and data analytics — with a few services alongside it, such as online insurance applications.
services.groupSoftwareSubtitle: Custom software solutions, from idea to launch — to the highest quality, delivered fast and cost-effectively
services.software1Desc: We study your processes and goals closely, then design and build software made precisely for them. Development moves step by step and intelligently, with as much automation as possible and always under your oversight — from consulting and estimates to deployment and maintenance.
services.software2Desc: Fast, responsive, user-friendly web apps, websites and mobile apps that work well on every device — on a scalable architecture for a growing business, with a focus on performance, security and user experience.
services.software3Desc: Systems and platforms that bring government, organisations, institutions and people closer together — from service portals and request-and-tracking systems to admin panels with access levels — so every service is just one click away.
services.software4Desc: We collect and organise scattered data and turn it into interactive dashboards, clear reports and key performance indicators, so decisions rest on data and come simpler and smarter.
services.processSubtitle: From ideation through design, development, deployment and maintenance — transparent and step by step
services.process1Desc: We listen to your needs, goals and constraints and turn the idea into a clear scope — with a free cost estimate and technical proposal.
services.process2Desc: We design the technical architecture, user flows and interface, and finalise them with you before development starts.
services.process3Desc: The software is built and tested in short, visible iterations, so you can see progress and give feedback at every step.
services.process4Desc: We launch the software and stay with you afterwards through maintenance, updates and technical support.
services.why1Desc: Clean, tested and documented code, built to current software engineering standards.
services.why2Desc: Intelligent, step-by-step development shortens the road from idea to product.
services.why3Desc: A transparent, free estimate, and open-source technology instead of expensive licences.
services.why4Desc: Built on open standards and open-source technology, so your software always stays free to extend.
services.groupInsuranceSubtitle: One of our secondary services — apply online for any kind of insurance on this site, track it with a tracking code, and get advice on the right plan
services.service1Desc: Our specialists find and recommend the plans and packages that best fit your needs and budget.
services.service2Desc: Apply for any cover — from third-party and car body to supplementary health, life and liability — on a form made for that product, with a verified phone number.
services.service3Desc: Check the status of your request at any time, with your tracking code or from your user dashboard.
services.service4Desc: Our support team answers your questions at every stage, from choosing a plan to completing your request.

project.title: Request software design and development
project.subtitle: Describe your idea or need — from custom software and web and mobile apps to enterprise platforms and data analytics. After review, you receive our analysis of the real scope, a timeline and a price range, free and without obligation.
project.step1: You describe the need, goals, constraints and budget, and attach any documents that help.
project.step2: Our specialists review the request and ask about anything the brief leaves unclear.
project.step3: You receive a formal proposal: scope, deliverables, assumptions, what is NOT included, timeline and a price range.
project.step4: You read it under your tracking code and accept or decline — with no commitment until you accept.

Get a tracking code; our expert states the exact price and completes the purchase.
thirdParty.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about the price
faqs: What is my exact insurance price?
It depends on your car, no-claim discount, late penalties and this year’s tariff. Submitting a quote request is free, and the exact price is stated by our expert.
Does getting a quote cost anything or commit me?
No. Submitting a request and receiving a tracking code is completely free and creates no obligation to buy.
How much does the no-claim discount save?
It depends on your claim-free history and is usually the largest price reducer; receiving a claim resets it to zero.
What if my insurance has already expired?
A per-day penalty is added to the premium for late renewal — the sooner you renew, the lower the penalty.
Is the price the same across all insurance companies?
The base tariff is the same, but discounts and payment terms can create small differences between insurers.
